note.label: OR consent context
paragraphs: I've been receiving some feedback from OR leadership in Antioch, in particular, about consents not being placed in a timely fashion. Just a reminder that when you place the case request, please add consent. One of the barriers that I have shared with our OR leadership is that when cases get bumped to the next day, particularly ERCPs, the consent has to be redone. This amount of rework adds to our clerical burden and is not sustainable given the increase in volume of our cases, but let's do what we can to meet our OR teams halfway.
